Held buy for 3 consecutive sessions, but RSI is sideways at 60, failing to enter overbought.
MACD histogram also worsened from 380 to 323 in 5 days, indicating slowing upward momentum.
Volume is also subdued at 0.65x the 5-day average, showing a lack of direction.
Weekly ADX at 29.9 suggests an uptrend, but daily ADX at 11.7 indicates a non-trending phase, warranting caution.
